item.tib: spyi spungs gab pa gsung chen las khro rgyal lha rgod thog pa'i zhi khro dbyings kyi bskang bshags
item.coloph: ces pa gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi nang nas/ gab pa gsung chen khro mchog lha rgod thog pa'i rgyud las/ zhi khro dbyings kyi skong rdzogs chen mo 'di yang / 'chi med yab sras gshen gsum gyis gtan la phab cing / dbal gshen stag la me 'bar gnyer du gtad nas/ gdung rabs rim bzhin du brgyud de mkhas pa mi bzhi'i rings la g.yung drung gi bon rab tu gnyan par bzhugs/ dus res shig na nam mkha' stong pa la rlung gi 'khor los dbang bsgyur te/ bstan pa dar nub kyi skabs su/ gter kha cha cig dang ra khyung rdzong la sbas/ cha gcig bla chen dran pa'i thugs la gab/ cha gcig srid pa'i rgyal mo la gnyer du gtad nas bcol lo/ phyis su snyigs ma rtsod ldan lnga yi dus kyi bskal pa la/ sde brgyad 'dul ba'i dbal bon khro bo lha rgod thog pa'i thugs kyi 'od zer las sprul pa'i/ stag la'i thugs sras dbra khyung sngags 'chang dbal 'bar stag slag can la snyan du brgyud cing dar ba'i rgyu lags pa la/ snyigs ma'i dus su mi rnams las 'phro zhan pa dang / dbal gshen de nyid kyis gdul bya'i 'gro rnams re 'dod rgya chen skong dgos stabs/ 'phro lus song kyang (yang /)dbal gshen de nyid kyi phyag len grub pa'i shog dril yod tshad bstan 'gro'i mig sman du gyur ba'i 7dbra khyung bla ma g.yung drung nas bka' dri med khyung chen gtsug gi nor bu 'dra ba'i gdams pa de nyid sum glang gyim shod du spyan drangs te/ bstan 'gror phan pa'i thugs bskyed mi dman par gnang bzhin/ phran bdag gi spyi bor pheb pa la/ bdag gis lha dbang lag gi nor bu 'chang ba ltar du bgyis nas yod skabs/ rang dang mched grogs gsum tsam mun mtshams zhe dgu la bsdad pa'i thun mtshams la/ gsas mkhar 'di yi dkyil 'khor mngon zhal bstan te/ bka' gtad rjes gnang gtad gnyer mdzad pa'i snang cha byung ba dang / ma zad gyim shod shel le rgya skar mjal du song ba'i nub mor/ dbal gshen stag slag can dang ma cig srid rgyal mo gnyis mngon sum zhal bstan te/ dbang lung man ngag yongs rdzogs mdzad cing / 'phro lus rnams spel dgos pa'i gnyer gtad gnang zhing*/ gsang bas rag tas bsre ba mdzad de bka' yi bkyon pa char ltar phab cing yang yang gsung gnang mdzad pa la brten nas/ shar grol smin grol gling du ma cig lha mo ma cig bu gdung gi tshul du 'grogs pa'i d+ha na tsi ta hri ho ces ming thog pa/ tshe dbang bla ma'i rjes 'breng tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am gsang ming g.yung drung thog med rtsal du 'bod pa bdag la/ snying slob bsgres po shes rab phun tshogs kyis dad pas yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ ma cig srid pa'i rgyal mo'i zhal lung bzhin du dkar chag yi ger btab pa bzhin thog mar drung yig pa btsun gzugs sa trig ming gis legs par bskrun pa'o//
